text:
Ava: FYI saw a p99 hill to ~1.6s during the noon ramp (2190012345) — looks like concurrent kernel flips + KV shard cold on newly scaled pods.
Miguel: can you drop the probe/autoscaler events for that window?
Ava: pasted excerpt below — prober moved kernel knl-fast -> knl-safe twice within 14s while autoscaler added 3 pods. new-pod kv_hit_rate was ~28% for first 20s.
Priya: any quick config we can tweak while we investigate?
Ava: current service config (redacted):
```
autoscaler:
  policy: reactive
  scale_step: 2
  ramp_limit_s: 15
prober:
  window_s: 8
  flip_threshold: 0.18
batcher:
  microbatch_target_items: 14
  microbatch_max_items: 20
kernel_selector: minimize_p99
kv:
  shard_prefetch: off
  delta_cache: true
```
bench-bot: [sample] knl-fast median per-token ~36ms, knl-safe ~82ms; new-pod KV cold-first-token penalty ~330-380ms.
Miguel: that aligns: p95 ~210-260ms stable, p99 spikes come from (1) KV-first-token penalty on cold nodes and (2) extra latency from fallback kernel path.
Lina: flamegraphs?
Ava: quick flame: knl-fast hot path = fused-attention + memcpy; knl-safe has extra alloc churn + a mutex in kv access path. Looks like the fallback path serializes a small cache population loop.
Priya: short-term mitigations we can apply tonight:
- increase prober.window_s -> 24s to avoid flips during short ramps
- enable best-effort shard_prefetch on container start (soft prewarm)
- add a node_age heuristic to kernel selector: avoid flips on nodes < 30s old
- temporary microbatch_max_items -> 12 for this service when slope>0.5
Miguel: longer-term idea: autoscaler runway-derivative estimator — compute dQ/dt (request slope) and trigger staged prewarm + kernel handshake ahead of actual scale events. config prototype: {"runway_derivative_threshold":0.15, "staged_preheat_s":20}.
Ava: ran a staging validation with soft prewarm + prober window bump. Results: p95 ~215ms, p99 median across 10 runs dropped from ~1.6s -> ~480ms. KV-first-token misses reduced by ~72%.
bench-bot: queued presubmit perf job #4782 for the staged-preheat branch.
Priya: note: lowering microbatch size helps tails but reduces throughput. We'll make a per-model microbatch hysteresis policy rather than global.
Miguel: also check whether knl-safe path extra latency is from copies or synchronization. If it's copy-heavy we can optimize memcpy; if it's sync we need to rework the cache population.
Ava: added flamegraphs + memcpy profile to PERF-1211.
Lina: ops ask: can eng-sre reserve a tiny runway buffer for the next 48h during peak windows while we iterate?
ops-bot: reserving +1 soft node during 11:30-12:30 UTC for the next 48h for the service (slope threshold 0.6) — acknowledged.
Miguel: rollout plan: (1) apply soft shard_prefetch + prober.window change to Dedicated subset, (2) run controlled 2x ramp tests and measure p99, (3) if green, roll to Hosted and enable derivative-runway in the autoscaler.
Ava: I'll attach the staging traces and open a short checklist for the deploy (validate prober window, node_age heuristic present, bench job green).
Priya: also add CI gate: any commit touching kernel_selector must run a 60s microburst perf test in CI.
Miguel: one follow-up experiment: compare staircase vs smooth ramp with same total QPS while enabling derivative prewarm; hypothesize smooth + prewarm will minimize flips.
Ava: scheduling experiments tonight. I'll post results in this thread. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
